title: Source-to-claim boundary crosswalk for eight purposively selected published irrigation advisory cases
provenance: Compiled from the working manuscript 01_Wiley_Manuscript_AUTHOR_REVIEW_NOT_SUBMITTED, source references and editorial notes. Not a systematic literature search or independent reanalysis.
limitations: No proprietary company data, field measurements, reconstruction of unresolved denominators, validated adoption rate or pooled effect. Exact original source versions and permissions must be adjudicated by the author before journal submission.

items.do_not_infer: population adoption rate; guaranteed water saving; resolved F7 source effect
items.unresolved_verification: F7 water productivity and reported percentages disagree

items.source_supported_qualitative_boundary: published enrolment areas, questionnaire percentages as reported, modelled scenarios
items.do_not_infer: independent daily adherence or realized 25 percent savings
items.unresolved_verification: dated farmer rosters and item-specific survey denominators unavailable

items.observation_unit: field-observation site versus virtual workshop decision
items.source_supported_qualitative_boundary: model validation and participant choices in their separate evidence units
items.do_not_infer: actual on-farm implementation or attributed field savings from virtual decisions
items.unresolved_verification: no linked prospective advice-to-action field event ledger inspected
items.verification_status: source-limited; human-machine interaction not farmer adherence

items.source_supported_qualitative_boundary: gross applied irrigation contrast and within-site crop measurements
items.do_not_infer: nine independent commercial farms or basin-scale conservation
items.unresolved_verification: regional depletion and externally replicated adoption not measured here
items.verification_status: published experimental case; narrow field-inference boundary

items.source_supported_qualitative_boundary: submitted inputs and self-reported SMS utility with source-labeled denominators
items.do_not_infer: verified advice-specific water saving or reconstructed universal adherence
items.unresolved_verification: contradictory respondent group totals in Table 5
items.verification_status: source-limited; no independent publisher correction authenticated

items.observation_unit: six commercial processing-tomato farms (2018, Foggia province, Italy), each split into DSS and usual grower-management main plots; farm is paired comparison unit
items.source_supported_qualitative_boundary: ISHS abstract reports DSS-vs-grower-management seasonal irrigation volume 24% lower and nitrogen 7% lower, without statistically significant detected difference in marketable yield; no quantitative non-inferiority is established
items.do_not_infer: twelve independent farms, randomised assignment, independent event-level adoption, equivalence of yield, transportable causal water-saving rate, or post-2018 voluntary uptake
items.unresolved_verification: Full plot-assignment methods, confidence intervals/equivalence margin, original meter and nitrogen records, event-level advice receipt and action logs were not independently checked
items.review_scope: SOURCE_ABSTRACT_ONLY; independent author full-text adjudication still required

items.observation_unit: six scheduling methods versus interviewed users
items.source_supported_qualitative_boundary: seasonal scheduling-method comparison and qualitative user feedback
items.do_not_infer: five-of-six farmer adoption or measured event-level fidelity
items.unresolved_verification: supplementary Data S1 and interview-specific denominator not verified
items.verification_status: publisher-abstract scope; distinct method and respondent units

items.observation_unit: centre-pivot maize plot and modelled alternative; crop-season
items.source_supported_qualitative_boundary: farmer schedule comparisons with optimised scenarios
items.do_not_infer: unqualified year-two effect; independently observed causal adoption
